st: An apple full of chemistry, AI agents passing ideas to each other, threatened bananas and an mRNA therapy that rekindles hope against melanoma.

sec.p: They say a golden rule for telling whether a food is good for you is to count the ingredients on the label. Or - better - to look for the ones with no label at all (fruit and vegetables). But, but, but. Here are the ingredients of a product that, I'm sure, you ate in the last…

Still on food, another idea from Tim Spector's book (often a guest or host on the ZOE podcast): The Gros Michel, once dominant in exports, was almost wiped out of commercial plantations by Panama disease. The Cavendish replaced it, but today it is threatened by the TR4 strain…
